title: Sharma Ji Ka Beta & Parent Comparisons
content: The quintessential Indian family trope where parents constantly compare their child's academic or career achievements with 'Sharma ji ka beta' (the neighbor's son) to induce guilt, academic pressure, and taunts about career or marriage.

title: Hera Pheri & Baburao Meme Templates
content: Iconic Hindi comedy movie Hera Pheri featuring Baburao Ganpatrao Apte (Paresh Rawal), Raju (Akshay Kumar), and Shyam (Suniel Shetty). Popular catchphrases include 'Utha le re baba', 'Gajab bezzati hai', 'Mast plan hai', and 'Yeh Baburao ka style hai', widely used for satirical double-meaning or desperate situational humor.

title: MS Dhoni & Thala Memes
content: MS Dhoni, fondly known as 'Thala', famous for number 7, finishing matches in style with helicopter shots, lightning fast stumpings, and cool composure ('Captain Cool'). Memes often play on 'Thala for a reason' or 7-related coincidences.

title: Virat Kohli & RCB IPL Rivalry
content: Virat Kohli (King Kohli), known for intense passion, aggressive celebrations, chase mastery, and the fanbase slogan 'Ee Sala Cup Namde' for Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB) amidst IPL rivalries with CSK and MI.

title: JEE NEET & Kota Coaching Culture
content: The hyper-competitive entrance exam environment in India for engineering (JEE) and medical (NEET). Features Kota coaching hubs (Allen, Resonance), intense pressure, sleepless nights, rank races, HC Verma physics book, cutoffs, and exam paper leaks.

title: Panchayat Web Series & Rural Slang
content: Desi web series Panchayat featuring iconic rural comedy dialogues like 'Gajab bezzati hai' (What a total humiliation!), Binod, Pradhan ji, and Sachiv ji, reflecting authentic rural North Indian humor and social awkwardness.

title: Indian Engineering & Academic Pressure
content: Intense societal and parental pressure on academic excellence in India, prioritizing Engineering/Medical, rote learning, report card anxiety, board exam hype, and mandatory tuition classes.

title: College Attendance 75% Rule & Backlogs
content: College life in India involves mandatory 75% attendance rules, internal exams, KT/backlogs, placement and campus interview anxiety, hostel life, mess food struggles, and canteen hangouts.

title: Chai, Pani Puri & Street Food Obsession
content: Obsession with chai/tea (cutting chai, biscuits), street food (pani puri/golgappa, momos, samosa, chole bhature), midnight Maggi in hostels, paneer vs non-veg debates, and bargaining with vegetable vendors.

title: Diwali Safai & Soan Papdi Forwarding
content: Diwali festival humor centering on deep cleaning the house ('Diwali ki safai'), endless re-gifting/forwarding of Soan Papdi sweet boxes, firecracker bans, rangoli, and lighting up diyas.

title: Arranged Marriage Matrimonial & Shaadi Relatives
content: Big fat Indian weddings, arranged marriage matrimonial Biodata, nosy relatives asking 'shaadi kab karoge?', buffet food rush, dowry discussions, and extravagant ceremonies.

title: Nibba Nibbi Cringe Romance Tropes
content: Conservative societal attitudes towards dating, sneaking calls from parents, 'nibba-nibbi' cringe teenage romance tropes, breakups, friendzones, ex drama, and eternal bachelorhood (singlehood).

title: Corporate IT Culture & Appraisal Pain
content: Corporate IT/office culture in India: demanding bosses, unpaid weekend overtime, appraisal disillusionment, 90-day notice periods, HR team activity distractions vs real hikes, and Work From Home (WFH) challenges.

title: Log Kya Kahenge & Jugaad Hacks
content: 'Log kya kahenge' (What will people/society say?), aggressive bargaining, Jugaad (creative improvised hacks), superstition (nimbu-mirchi), and relative comparisons.

title: Delhi, Mumbai & Bengaluru Regional Stereotypes
content: Regional stereotypes and city traits: Delhi winters/smog/aggression ('Tu janta hai mera baap kaun hai'), Mumbai local trains and monsoons, Bengaluru traffic and startup tech-bro jargon, Bihar UPSC aspirants.

title: Middle Class Tropes & IRCTC Tatkal Panic
content: Middle-class life tropes: bargaining with auto/rickshaw drivers, meter refusal, power cuts, IRCTC tatkal ticket booking panic, reusing plastic dabbas, and saving money.

title: Desi Slang & Conversational Expressions
content: Desi slang, conversational fillers, and street expressions (e.g., 'Arey yaar', 'Bawa', 'Bhau', 'Chai-sutta', 'Bakchodi', 'Scene kya hai', 'L lag gaye', 'Gajab bezzati hai', 'Mast plan hai'). Often used for comedic hyperbole and expressive informal tone.

title: Viral Indian Internet Memes
content: Viral Indian internet memes, YouTuber references (CarryMinati, BB Ki Vines), viral catchphrases ('Binod', 'Rasode me kaun tha', 'Pawri hori hai', 'Ruk jaa bhai', 'Choti bacchi ho kya'), and Desi Reddit/Instagram meme templates.
